acceptance_predicates.description: Every control lifecycle test allocates an isolated state root and cannot collide with another test process.
The ordinary cargo test --locked --workspace command passes repeatedly without state-root ownership failures.
Authenticated lifecycle, private bundle-root, cleanup, and recovery tests retain their existing positive and negative semantics.
No credentials, private paths, raw control payloads, or unbounded logs enter durable evidence.

definition_of_done: The exact reproducible state-root collision is repaired with focused positive and negative tests.
Independent exact-head review, signed DCO commit, exact-head CI, protected merge, and exact-main post-merge workflows pass.
AR-1785 can be re-reviewed and published without a parallel workspace test flake.

outputs.description: Deterministic per-test control state-root ownership and cleanup.

gates.description: Control lifecycle and state-root isolation tests pass with concurrent hostile fixtures.
